extracted.intended_audience: general viewers of VICE Asia videos; people interested in wrestling, improv comedy, and documentary-style short videos
extracted.subtask_description: A web-page metadata/description entry for a short documentary/feature video (VICE Asia) about the overlap between wrestling and improv comedy in Chicago, including synopsis, credits, and social/subscribe links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content flagging categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag this item for: Graphic Violence; Explicit Sexual Content; Hate Speech; Misinformation/Disinformation; Marketing/Phishing/Advertising; Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page exposes the set of moderation/flag reasons available to users to report the item. Use these categories when evaluating whether the item violates site policies or should be flagged for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video description components
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a concise synopsis that answers the hook (e.g., 'Is there a link between improv comedy and wrestling?'), names the host/participants (e.g., 'Madeleine Sami', 'Colt Cabana'), highlights what viewers will see (ring moves, improv performance, local food), and a call-to-action (e.g., 'Click here to SUBSCRIBE to VICE Asia').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page illustrates an effective video item description: short lead sentence posing the topic, brief paragraph summarizing scenes and notable people, viewer enticements ('Watch now for all of that plus...'), and links/CTAs to subscribe, follow on social, and view more content (full video catalog, social links). Also include metadata fields like Publication date, Item Size, Addeddate, Collections, and Identifier for discoverability.
